CN-113924265-B.title: Autonomous omnidirectional drive unit
CN-113924265-B.abstract: The autonomous omnidirectional drive unit comprises: a drive chassis (10) supported on two independent, parallel and coaxial drive wheels (11) actuated by at least two drive motors (12); a transport chassis (20 ), the central area of which is superimposed on the drive chassis and connected to the drive chassis by a swivel joint (30), the transport chassis is supported on a plurality of omnidirectional wheels. The drive unit also comprises a swivel device actuated by a swivel motor (32) supported in the transport chassis, integrated in a swivel joint between the transport chassis and the drive chassis, the swivel motor determining the drive chassis an angular position relative to the transport chassis; and a control device configured to coordinately adjust the at least two drive motors and the swivel motor to obtain omnidirectional movement of the transport chassis.

independent_claims.original_text: 一种自主全向驱动单元，包括： ·驱动底盘，所述驱动底盘至少被支撑在与水平轴线同轴的两个独立的平行驱动轮上，每个驱动轮由包括在所述驱动底盘中的驱动马达致动； ·运输底盘，具有中心区域，通过与竖直轴线同轴的旋转接头被叠置于且连接至所述驱动底盘上，所述竖直轴线在两个所述驱动轮之间与所述水平轴线相交，所述运输底盘在外围区域围绕所述驱动底盘延伸，所述运输底盘被支撑在围绕所述驱动底盘分布的多个脚轮上； 所述驱动单元还包括： ·旋转装置，所述旋转装置与所述竖直轴线同心且被集成在处于所述运输底盘与所述驱动底盘之间的所述旋转接头中，由被支撑在所述运输底盘中的旋转马达致动，所述旋转马达确定所述驱动底盘相对于所述运输底盘围绕所述竖直轴线的角位置，以及 ·控制装置，所述控制装置被配置成用于以协作方式调节至少两个所述驱动马达和所述旋转马达，以获得所述运输底盘的全向移动；而且 所述旋转装置包括齿圈，所述齿圈被集成地附接至所述驱动底盘，且连接至由所述旋转马达致动的齿轮。
根据权利要求1所述的自主全向驱动单元，其中，所述驱动底盘包括放置在所述驱动轮与所述旋转接头之间的减震装置。
根据权利要求2所述的自主全向驱动单元，其中，所述减震装置由被放置在所述驱动底盘的第一部分与所述驱动底盘的第二部分之间的弹性能压缩元件组成，所述第一部分支撑所述驱动轮，所述第二部分支撑所述旋转接头。

1: 一种自主全向驱动单元，包括：1. An autonomous omnidirectional drive unit comprising:

·驱动底盘，所述驱动底盘至少被支撑在与水平轴线同轴的两个独立的平行驱动轮上，每个驱动轮由包括在所述驱动底盘中的驱动马达致动；a drive chassis supported on at least two independent parallel drive wheels coaxial with a horizontal axis, each driven wheel being actuated by a drive motor included in said drive chassis;

·运输底盘，具有中心区域，通过与竖直轴线同轴的旋转接头被叠置于且连接至所述驱动底盘上，所述竖直轴线在两个所述驱动轮之间与所述水平轴线相交，所述运输底盘在外围区域围绕所述驱动底盘延伸，所述运输底盘被支撑在围绕所述驱动底盘分布的多个脚轮上；a transport chassis with a central area superposed and connected to said drive chassis by means of a swivel joint coaxial with a vertical axis between two of said drive wheels and said horizontal axis intersecting, the transport chassis extending around the drive chassis in a peripheral region, the transport chassis being supported on a plurality of castors distributed around the drive chassis;
所述驱动单元还包括：The drive unit also includes:

·旋转装置，所述旋转装置与所述竖直轴线同心且被集成在处于所述运输底盘与所述驱动底盘之间的所述旋转接头中，由被支撑在所述运输底盘中的旋转马达致动，所述旋转马达确定所述驱动底盘相对于所述运输底盘围绕所述竖直轴线的角位置，以及Rotary device, concentric with the vertical axis and integrated in the swivel joint between the transport chassis and the drive chassis, driven by a rotary motor supported in the transport chassis actuated, the rotary motor determines the angular position of the drive chassis relative to the transport chassis about the vertical axis, and

·控制装置，所述控制装置被配置成用于以协作方式调节至少两个所述驱动马达和所述旋转马达，以获得所述运输底盘的全向移动；而且· control means configured for regulating at least two of said drive motors and said swivel motor in a cooperative manner to obtain omnidirectional movement of said transport chassis; and
所述旋转装置包括齿圈，所述齿圈被集成地附接至所述驱动底盘，且连接至由所述旋转马达致动的齿轮。The rotary means includes a ring gear integrally attached to the drive chassis and connected to a gear actuated by the rotary motor.
2: 根据权利要求1所述的自主全向驱动单元，其中，所述驱动底盘包括放置在所述驱动轮与所述旋转接头之间的减震装置。2. The autonomous omnidirectional drive unit of claim 1, wherein the drive chassis includes shock absorbing means placed between the drive wheels and the swivel joint.
3: 根据权利要求2所述的自主全向驱动单元，其中，所述减震装置由被放置在所述驱动底盘的第一部分与所述驱动底盘的第二部分之间的弹性能压缩元件组成，所述第一部分支撑所述驱动轮，所述第二部分支撑所述旋转接头。3. Autonomous omnidirectional drive unit according to claim 2

wherein said shock absorbing means consists of an elastic energy compressive element placed between a first part of said drive chassis and a second part of said drive chassis, the first part supports the drive wheel, and the second part supports the rotary joint.

CN-113905972-B.title: Compact autonomous omnidirectional drive unit
CN-113905972-B.abstract: The invention relates to an autonomous omnidirectional drive unit comprising: a chassis (40), the chassis (40) defining a front third (41), a middle third (42) and a rear third, wherein the front third (41) comprises a first drive wheel (11) with a first gearbox (13), a second drive wheel (21) with a second gearbox (23) coaxial with a horizontal geometrical axis (EH), and a battery (30) located between the first drive wheel (11) and the second drive wheel (21); the middle third (42) comprises a first motor (12) and a second motor (22) connected to the first and second driving wheels (11, 21) and a vertical housing (70) concentric with the vertical geometric axis (12) between the first motor (12) and the second motor (22); and the rear third contains at least one castor (50), wherein the first and second motors (12, 22) are controlled by a control device (80), which control device (80) generates control commands in view of the distance (D) existing between the horizontal and vertical geometric axes (EH, EV).

independent_claims.text: A compact autonomous omnidirectional drive unit, comprising: a first drive assembly constituted by a first drive wheel coaxial with a horizontal geometric axis, said first drive wheel being connected by a first gearbox to a first motor parallel to said horizontal geometric axis; a second drive assembly constituted by a second drive wheel coaxial with the horizontal geometric axis, said second drive wheel being connected by a second gearbox to a second motor parallel to the horizontal geometric axis; a battery connected to the first and second motors; a chassis defining a front third, a middle third and a rear third of the autonomous omnidirectional drive unit and a vertical geometric axis at a central position of the chassis, the chassis supporting the first and second drive assemblies spaced apart from each other in the direction of the horizontal geometric axis and supporting one or more casters; a horizontal transport platform located on the chassis for transporting a load; a vertical housing concentric with the vertical geometric axis and configured to allow routing between the autonomous omnidirectional drive unit to the transport platform and/or for accommodating a load lifting device configured to lift the transport platform or to lift a load located on the transport platform in the direction of the vertical geometric axis; and -control means configured to control the first motor and the second motor by calculating generated control commands to cause the autonomous omnidirectional drive unit to generate a planned translation about the vertical geometric axis; the method is characterized in that: the one or more casters are located at the rear third; -said first motor and said second motor are located at said middle third, with said vertical housing arranged therebetween; -said first and second driving wheels are located at said front third, between which said battery is housed, and said horizontal geometric axis is spaced from said vertical geometric axis by a distance; and is also provided with The control device is configured to perform the calculation, which directly or indirectly comprises the distance as a calculation parameter.

DE-19909020-A1.title: Electric drive for hand-steered golf trolley, shopping trolley or pushchair has drive wheel with central axis offset from central axes of normal trolley wheels
DE-19909020-A1.abstract: The electric drive is used for rotation of a drive wheel (3) having a central axis which is offset from the central axes of the trolley wheels (7,8), so that the latter are lifted from the ground, when the drive wheel is brought into contact with the ground, in the transport position of the golf trolley. The electric drive and the drive wheel may be attached to an existing trolley via an adapter (4) so that the drive wheel is positioned midway between the trolley wheels.

US-2024198727-A1.title: Controller and method for controlling casters attached to a movable part
US-2024198727-A1.abstract: A controller and a method for controlling casters attached to a movable part such as a hospital bed, for switching the castors between a state in which the castor is pivot locked and rotationally blocked, and a state in which there is neither a pivot locking nor a rotational blocking, additionally switchable into a state in which the caster is only pivot locked, actuatable electrically and also manually, movement sensor. Multiple switching states may be automatically and sequentially assumed in a predetermined sequence, a first switching state in which there is neither a pivot locking nor a rotational blocking, which a second switching state, in which one or more or all castors are pivot locked, however not rotationally blocked, and finally a switching state, in which all switchable casters are again pivot locked and rotationally blocked.

JP-2012066007-A.title: Differential caster and electric wheelchair
JP-2012066007-A.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a differential caster suitable for an outer rotor type brushless motor, and an electric wheelchair.SOLUTION: The differential caster 41 includes a mounting plate 51; a steering shaft 53 rotatably supported to the mounting plate 51; a motor holder 101 provided at one end of the steering shaft 53 so as to intersect the steering shaft 53; a pair of wheels 136 supported on both axial end sides of the motor holder 101; and electric motors 100 built in the pair of wheels 136 respectively. A driving control substrate 120 for controlling driving of the electric motor 100 is disposed between the electric motor 100 and the steering shaft 53.

independent_claims.text: A main shaft rotatably supported on the mounting plate; An auxiliary shaft provided at one end of the main shaft so as to intersect the main shaft; A pair of drive wheels supported at both axial ends of the auxiliary shaft; In the differential caster provided with the electric motor built in each of the pair of drive wheels, A differential caster, wherein a drive control board for performing drive control of the electric motor is disposed between the electric motor and the main shaft.

EP-2999448-B1.title: Assisted propulsion system, method and chassis

independent_claims.text: An assisted propulsion system (10) for a wheeled chassis of a patient handling equipment that is moveable along a surface (S), the assisted propulsion system comprising: a drive (20) coupleable to the chassis (60) via a mount (30) and arranged to provide assisted propulsion to the chassis along the surface (S), the mount (30) substantially decoupling at least a driving part (21) of the drive from the chassis (60) in a direction substantially perpendicular to the surface (S) and being arranged to apply a resilient spring force to direct at least the driving part (21) of the drive onto the surface (S) during provision of said assisted propulsion; a controller (40) arranged to control operation of the drive (20); and a sensor (50) arranged i) to monitor acceleration of at least a part of the drive; and ii) to communicate data on said acceleration to the controller (40), wherein the controller (40) is arranged to control operation of the drive (20) in dependence on the data received from the sensor, wherein the controller is arranged to receive a control input from an operator of the chassis and is arranged to control operation of the multi-directional drive in dependence on the control input and on the data received from the sensor, wherein the controller is arranged to determine a change to the velocity and/or acceleration of the multi-directional drive from the control input and is arranged to determine a magnitude of said change in dependence on the control input and the data received from the sensor.

The assisted propulsion system of claim1 or 2, wherein the driving part is substantially fixedly connected to the mount (30) to transmit forces from the driving part (21) to the mount in all directions except towards or away from the surface (S) whereby said decoupling is configured to cause the driving part (21) to move under the resilient spring force to substantially absorb forces directions substantially towards or away from the surface (S).

A chassis for a patient handling equipment for conveying a payload along a surface comprising: a plurality of wheels (62) disposed about the chassis (60) for supporting the chassis on the surface (S); and an assisted propulsion system according to any one of claims 1 to 3.
